description: This file defines a React functional component 'GitHubExamplesCTA' that renders a styled call-to-action element. It imports primitive UI components (Alert, Button) and an icon (ArrowR) to build a clickable button linking to the Keystone GitHub examples directory.

methods.name: GitHubExamplesCTA
